events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in global markets, particularly in the energy sector. The US has warned of potential retaliation against Iran.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to increased oil prices, which would negatively impact the energy sector. However, the overall market may see a boost due to safe-haven bids. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy option, while the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) is a good short option.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the oil prices stabilize.
